candidates.title: Absentee/mail-in ballot receipt deadlines by state
candidates.snippet: States have different deadlines for when absentee/mail-in ballots must be received in order to be counted. In some states, these deadlines can also vary based on whether the ballot is returned by mail or in person, and whether the voter is a member of the United States military or living overseas.
